mapper.sql: id, sku_id, reserved_stocks, available_stocks, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sku_stock (sku_id, reserved_stocks, available_stocks, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{skuId}, #{reservedStocks}, #{availableStocks}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sku_stock SET sku_id = #{skuId}, reserved_stocks = #{reservedStocks}, available_stocks = #{availableStocks}, create_time = #{createTime}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE id = #{id}
